title: Independent math review of the Relativistic reconstruction section (refs #478)
body:
## Result and scope

Refs #478

- Claim comment URL and session: https://github.com/hairer/humanise-yang-mills/issues/478#issuecomment-6932290219 (session `ADB991-claude-20261116-3be0`)
- Unit IDs or other outputs: YM-000026. One new file: `blueprint/units/YM-000026/reviews/relativistic-reconstruction-math-review-ADB991-claude-20261116-3be0.md`. No manuscript, `unit.json` or Lean changes.
- Human contributors and agent assistance: Claude (Anthropic), sole reader and author; no subagents. Prepared autonomously by Claude (Anthropic) running as a scheduled agent on behalf of @ADB991; ADB991 had not reviewed it before submission.

This is an independent error-discovery review of the eleven files of the *Relativistic reconstruction* section at `main` 962ac43b. Every proof was read line by line, and its signs, conventions and quantifiers were recomputed. The checks included the complex heat sign `V(t)=e^{itH}`, the edge Taylor telescoping, the boost Ward identity at `c=iσ`, the tube margin and cutoff radii, the mixed heat Gram identity, the Paley-type support bound and the imaginary-boost locality argument.

**No error was found in the section's own proofs.**

- **F1 (required):** the *reference* Lorentz action `T_d^0` of Input `input:calibrated-actions` is not constructed anywhere in the monograph. The input requires a boost generator `-iL^0`, agreement with `R_d^0` on spatial rotations, and commutation with `J_d^0`. `physical-angular-actions.tex` treats this action as already fixed. Lean proves it in `YM.Maxwell.Free.voyage` / `launched` (`Lean/YM/Next/MAXWELL/Descent.lean:173-181`). The monograph needs a short subsection or a precise citation, with its sign conventions checked.
- **F2 (required, one sentence):** the identification of involutions assumed in `cor:word-motion-inputs` is not discharged by name in `assembly.tex`.
- **E1-E4 (editorial):** a stale "still to be proved" at fourier-support.tex:138; a duplicated vacuum-uniqueness argument; a forward reference in label-descent; and a missing pointer from reconstruction.tex to `thm:field-spectrum`.

## Evidence

- Pinned source revision: manuscript `962ac43b0ec22ec2831da438eadd8728de800b50`; Lean `3456e5e75cf8d4cd558955a5c7638fba2d68f464` (read only, unchanged).
- Commands actually run and results:
  - `python3 scripts/check_blueprint.py`: "Blueprint structure OK: 4 units".
  - `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`: 22 tests OK.
  - `python3 scripts/check_blueprint.py --fingerprint YM-000026`: `682a9588...93d3`.
  - `sha256sum` of the eleven files (recorded in the report).
  - `grep` searches over `manuscript/existence` and `Lean/YM`, as described in F1.
- Checks not performed and why:
  - No LaTeX build, since no `.tex` file changed.
  - No Lean build; the Lean files were read only.
  - The literature locators (Trèves 51.6, Reed–Simon VII.2, Williams 2.19, BHV D.3.1) were not re-verified against the originals: the sandbox proxy returned HTTP 403 for the PDFs. The report relies on the #472 record for them.
  - The upstream inputs to this section were not re-proved.
- Dependency/interface changes and affected units: none.

Required next review: mathematics (independent human), and an author response to F1/F2.
